The '''9th Assault Corps''' was a [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] within in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. It served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. The corps was under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. It included the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite]], a unit under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]]. This unit was renowned for their overwhelming firepower and offensive tactics. Commander Gree was [[Death|killed]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] when he tried to enforce [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The 41st additionally included [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], and the 9th featured [[Sarlacc Battalion A]] and [[Sarlacc Battalion B]] as subordinate units.
